title: Drone attack targets Moscow, prompting airport restrictions
summary: Drones attacked the Russian capital and the Moscow region. Two planes flying from Turkey to Moscow were diverted due to restrictions at Vnukovo Airport.

title: Military personnel can order NRK amphibious vehicles through Brave1 Market
summary: A new class of ground-based robotic systems—amphibious ground-based robotic systems—is now available on the Brave1 Market platform for the military.

title: Germany and Japan reaffirm commitment to continued support for Ukraine
summary: Germany and Japan have reaffirmed their commitment to continuing support for Ukraine and working closely together to achieve a just and lasting peace.

title: UN to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians
summary: The United Nations plans to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians from October 26, 2026, through March 2027, with about 84% of the aid earmarked for people living within 50 kilometers of the front line.

title: Demining underway along civilian evacuation routes from Oleshky to Lubinets
summary: Demining operations are currently underway along the routes used by civilians to leave the city of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

title: Two State Emergency Service bomb disposal experts killed during demining operation in Sumy region
summary: On October 28, in the Sumy region, two employees of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine were killed during a humanitarian demining operation.

title: Russia holds captive journalists in inhumane conditions, subjects them to torture – Lubinets
summary: Russian occupying forces are deliberately torturing Ukrainian journalists held in captivity and subjecting them to inhumane conditions.

title: New taxes in Russia fuel tensions between Kremlin and big business – intelligence
summary: Russian businesses are demanding a review of tax changes amid concerns over declining investment and capital outflows.
